mentions.name: IdleQuest
mentions.description: A from-scratch browser recreation of the 1999 MMORPG classic EverQuest, with a real-time MMO server written in Go, a 3D browser-based client built with Babylon.js, and the classic UI recreated in React. Playable as a regular MMORPG or in an idle mode that essentially plays itself; it has hosted up to 70 concurrent players, though bugs, unimplemented features, and balance issues remain.

mentions.name: IdleQuest
mentions.description: A browser-based idle/incremental game recreating the 1999 MMORPG EverQuest. It is relatively fully-featured compared to the original game, with new mechanics designed to make the idle format work, and has an active community of around 50 concurrent players plus a Discord group. The 3D graphics act more as a screensaver, with all game interactions handled through menus. Much of the game logic was recently moved client-side to reduce the cost of running a real-time MMORPG server, with new bugs still being resolved.
mentions.problem: Running a real-time MMORPG server is expensive, which motivated converting much of the game to be client-side instead of server-side.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made an idle version of the 1999 MMORPG "EverQuest". There's maybe around 50 people playing at any given time and has a enthusiastic discord group for it.
